_comment: Allowlist of Intune settings the model is permitted to recommend. Anything not
listed here is REJECTED by validate.py, no exceptions.
This file exists mainly because of the Apple DDM migration. Apple deprecated
MDM-based software update workloads and Intune is ending support for MDM-based
Apple software update policies; Microsoft's guidance is to use declarative
device management instead. There are no longer dedicated update policy blades
for iOS/macOS - everything moved to Settings Catalog profiles under the
A model working from older training data WILL confidently recommend the dead
'Devices > Update policies for iOS' blade. This allowlist is the only thing
that catches it. Review this file whenever Intune ships a release note.
deprecated_terms: Devices > Apple updates > iOS/iPadOS update policies

policy_paths: Devices > Configuration > Create policy > iOS/iPadOS > Settings catalog > Declarative Device Management (DDM) > Software Update
Devices > Compliance policies > Create policy > iOS/iPadOS
ios.minimum_os_note: Managed software updates via the settings catalog require iOS/iPadOS 17.0 or later. Devices below that fall back to compliance-policy enforcement only.

ddm_target_os_version.label: Software Update > Target OS Version
ddm_target_os_version.description: Pin devices to a specific OS version. Use for controlled rollout when app compatibility matters.

ddm_target_build_version.label: Software Update > Target Build Version
ddm_target_build_version.description: Build-level pin. Needed for rapid security responses, which carry versions like 16.5.1 (a).

ddm_target_local_date_time.label: Software Update > Target Local Date Time
ddm_target_local_date_time.description: Enforcement deadline in device-local time. The device installs autonomously by this point.

ddm_enforce_latest_deferral_days.label: Software Update Enforce Latest > Deferral (days)
ddm_enforce_latest_deferral_days.description: Auto-install the newest eligible OS after this many days. Simplest model; use when you always want current.

compliance_min_os_version.label: Compliance policy > Device Properties > Minimum OS version
compliance_min_os_version.description: Conditional Access lever. Non-compliant devices lose resource access. Pair with, do not substitute for, DDM.

compliance_min_os_build.label: Compliance policy > Device Properties > Minimum OS build version
compliance_min_os_build.description: Use when a rapid security response shares its marketing version with the base release.

policy_paths: Devices > Configuration > Create policy > macOS > Settings catalog > Declarative Device Management (DDM) > Software Update
Devices > Compliance policies > Create policy > macOS
macos.minimum_os_note: Managed software updates via the settings catalog require macOS 14.0 or later.

ddm_target_local_date_time.label: Software Update > Target Local Date Time

compliance_min_os_version.label: Compliance policy > Device Properties > Minimum OS version

policy_paths: Devices > Compliance policies > Create policy > Android Enterprise
Devices > Configuration > Create policy > Android Enterprise > Device restrictions > System update

compliance_min_security_patch_level.label: Compliance policy > Device Health > Minimum security patch level
compliance_min_security_patch_level.description: Maps 1:1 onto the Android bulletin patch-level date. Computed in code, never by the model.

compliance_min_os_version.label: Compliance policy > Device Properties > Minimum OS version

policy_paths: Devices > Windows > Update rings for Windows 10 and later
Devices > Windows > Feature updates for Windows 10 and later
Devices > Compliance policies > Create policy > Windows 10 and later

quality_update_deferral_days.label: Update ring > Quality update deferral period (days)

quality_update_deadline_days.label: Update ring > Deadline for quality updates (days)

auto_reboot_before_deadline.label: Update ring > Auto reboot before deadline

compliance_min_os_version.label: Compliance policy > Device Properties > Minimum OS version
compliance_min_os_version.description: Windows compliance uses full build numbers, e.g. 10.0.26100.1234 - not marketing names like 24H2.

deadline_policy._comment: Maximum days from ticket creation to enforced install, by severity. The validator rejects any model-proposed deadline outside these bounds.
